title: LYRA (organismic drone machine)
author: Arvid Solander (after SOMA Laboratory's LYRA-4; no SOMA code)
description: LYRA for the Digitone mk1 and Keys, a drone machine after SOMA's LYRA-4/8: four oscillators in two pairs, cross-modulated (SELF, PAIR, HLFO, CHN, DLY, or the partner track: TRK), a HYPER LFO and its own delay network, through the Digitone's filter and effects. One voice per track. LYRA LITE: the same with two oscillators and a 6 kHz delay, a third lighter. Machines 90 and 91.
